paper_metadata.title: Effect of niobium content on microstructural evolution and mechanical behavior of Alloy 625 Plus

evidence.quote: This study systematically investigates the effect of niobium content on the microstructural evolution and mechanical properties of a precipitation-hardened nickel-based superalloy.
Alloy 625 Plus (UNS N07716) exhibits a distinctive combination of advantageous features from both IN 625 (UNS N06625) and IN 718 (UNS N07718) alloys.
This study systematically investigated the influence of Nb content on microstructural evolution and mechanical properties of Alloy 625 Plus.

evidence.quote: Nb confers significant solid-solution strengthening in superalloys [16].
Niobium (Nb) enhances alloy mechanical performance via coordinated mechanisms including solid-solution strengthening, precipitation hardening, and grain refinement.
